findings.description: Direct V24 inspection of all five views and six poses shows the extended front apron still breaks across the seated lap: both fitted shorts and substantial upper-thigh areas remain visible in sit, and the crouch lap panels lift off the bent thighs. The V24 forwardHemThighWeight increase from 0.18 to 0.72 did not improve measured upper-thigh overskirt coverage: sit is 35.9% left / 35.5% right (V23: 37.6% / 36.8%), and crouch is 47.0% / 45.9%. Do not infer fit acceptance from this ray-coverage diagnostic.
V24 front, side, and rear renders retain irregular planar corrugation, pinched folds, and lumpy side/rear mass instead of deliberate continuous pleats.
Direct V24 back view still does not make the waist adjustment tab or buckle identifiable against the jacket and skirt.
The V24 source-bound mesh showcase records authored UV status MISSING. The topology SVG is not a UV layout.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V24 changes only the forward lap-follow weight from 0.18 to 0.72 while keeping the V23 apron geometry, centerline balance, waist anchoring, and 0.75 cap. Direct review of the new five-view/six-pose renders and bound pose diagnostic finds the lap still discontinuous over seated and crouched thighs; measured overskirt coverage did not improve. Skirt faceting and unreadable rear adjustment hardware persist.

nextAction: REJECT. Discard the V24 stronger-thigh-follow hypothesis; do not add more apron length or forward thigh weight. Replace the front-lap panel attachment/deformation approach with a continuous, overlapping panel that stays above both raised thighs in sit and crouch, then address controlled skirt folds and a legible rear tab/buckle. Author and verify real UVs on the current source. Rebuild as a new revision and directly inspect all five views and six poses. Fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat runtime, package, and release remain unverified or blocked.
